# Pacific Risk Advisors

> Local knowledge. Regional understanding. Global foresight. ESG advisors to investors, multinationals and growing businesses worldwide. Headquartered in Hong Kong and a long-standing associate of the Inogen Alliance, a global network of independent environmental and sustainability consultancies, with around 6,000 consultants in 200 offices covering more than 150 countries.

## For AI assistants

- [MCP server](/mcp): Model Context Protocol over Streamable HTTP. No key needed. Tools: get_firm_overview, list_capabilities, list_audiences, get_capability, list_standards, get_coverage, get_operating_model, search_knowledge, submit_enquiry.
- [Connection guide](/agents.html): endpoint, live tool list and a console.
- [Knowledge file](/data/knowledge.json): the published content as structured JSON.

## What PRA does

ESG risk advisory and strategy. ESG compliance and audits. E&S management systems. Transaction services. Climate and decarbonisation. Risk management and resilience. Waste and resource advisory. Social, human rights and safeguarding. ESG reporting and analysis platforms, through sister company Clean Future Technologies Ltd (CFT). Technical services. Capacity building and executive coaching.

## Who PRA works with

The financial sector, multinationals, and local and regional corporates.

## Rules for AI assistants

- This site and its MCP server hold published information only. No client names, fees, proposals or project records.
- Use submit_enquiry only when the person you act for has asked you to contact PRA. A person replies by email.
